correctness.rationale: With normalized doublons, sum L_x†L_x=2γP, so K=H−iγP and survival is squared no-jump norm. An eigenvector with real K eigenvalue lies in ker P and is an H eigenvector. Those vectors reduce K; on their complementary invariant subspace all eigenvalues decay, including any polynomial Jordan factor. At fixed total momentum Q not equal to π, coincidence of the two-cosine energies forces the same unordered momentum pair, and every such state has nonzero doublon amplitude. Distinct Q channels cannot cancel there by Fourier orthogonality. The even-ring Q=π flat sector loses one alternating doublon; the momentum involution has 2 fixed points for 4|n and 0 otherwise. The surviving projector has diagonal 1/n for a full-length separated orbit and (1+(−1)^{n/2})/n at the antipode, with zero doublon diagonal and no dark sector for odd rings. Independently built symmetric tensor matrices in /workspace/branches/ebf309d7-d5d1-4d92-8773-b1907fdc3b75/independent_check.py and independent_check.log agreed at all 360 localized states and ten ranks for 3≤n≤12, tolerance 2×10^{-8}. This is finite corroboration; the frozen script was read, not executed.
